parcel_identity.source: NYC Department of Buildings Local Law 97 Covered Buildings list (CY 2025)

historic_building.description: Two 1878 tenement buildings joined/altered into a four-story, four-bay lodging-house resource with a modest yellow/orange-brick Art Deco facade.
historic_building.source: Bowery Historic District National Register report
historic_building.conflict_note: Modern property aggregators often expose 1920 as a DOB/DOF year-built field. Do not overwrite the National Register's better-documented 1878/1934 historical chronology with that administrative value.

modern_envelope_secondary.note: Useful for sanity checking the full parcel/building shell only. Verify dimensions against NYC PLUTO/DOB survey records before treating as measured geometry. These dimensions describe the whole building/lot, not the historic CBGB tenant footprint.

retail_envelope_secondary.note: This is a retail/lease marketing envelope and must not be interpreted as the historic CBGB room width. It conflicts in scope, not necessarily fact, with whole-parcel dimensions.

club_history.predecessor: Palace Bar / Palace Hotel lodging-house bar
club_history.original_features_note: National Register documentation says Hilly Kristal retained the original bar and many original fixtures.
club_history.preservation_note: National Register documentation states the club interior was largely preserved after CBGB closed.
club_history.current_tenant_lead: John Varvatos currently lists a Bowery store at 315 Bowery; seek permission for a non-invasive survey rather than assuming current retail geometry equals 2006 CBGB.

historic_tenant_footprint.rule: Do not use the old 25x75 secondary-description estimate as authoritative geometry. The POC may use a clearly labeled placeholder shell only until dimensions/camera solves support a better footprint.

spatial_hypotheses_to_test.claim: The public room was long and narrow with the stage toward the rear.
The bar occupied a longitudinal side of the room and was inherited from the Palace Bar era.
Bathroom/stair access was near the stage/rear zone.

anchors_to_solve: Bowery facade plane and curb plane
stage center, plane, width, depth and height by historical period
historic bar start/end, face plane and wall offset
CB's Gallery / adjacent-space relationship where historically relevant
camera stations visible repeatedly across 1975-1980 archive footage

camera_solve_strategy.description: Treat repeated archival video/photo viewpoints as bundle-adjustment constraints. Human researchers may annotate homologous fixed features from reference-only media without copying the media into production training.
camera_solve_strategy.output: period-specific camera poses and geometry observations with source IDs, not extracted copyrighted textures

confidence_rule: Any dimension or placement below 0.85 confidence remains an estimate in the public POC. Debug/research mode must expose confidence and supporting evidence IDs.
